headline: EVER spikes 28.57% while TRITN plunges 33.33% intraday, marking the day's most divergent moves.
market_take: Construction stocks faced pressure with several sharp intraday declines and high volume spikes. Property showed the strongest upside, led by EVER (+28.57%) and AMATA (+5.45%). Food was mixed, with NRF gaining 8.70% and XBIO dropping 11.11% on an open gap. PF&REITs posted modest gains, highlighted by M-PAT's 7.14% price gap.

sector_notes.note: TRITN fell 33.33% intraday; SQ dropped 10.00% amid a 7.5σ volume spike; PLE showed a volatile +12.50% gap then -11.11% intraday; EMC recorded a 3.3σ volume spike and a 5‑day gain of 100%.
EVER surged 28.57% with solid volume; AMATA rose 5.45% following a high‑profile asset disposal filing; RABBIT and STELLA posted gains above 5%; JCK slipped 7.69% on an open gap.
NRF advanced 8.70% and posted a 13.64% intraday rise; XBIO dropped 11.11% on an open gap; TU filed multiple earnings and a connected transaction but showed no price move.
M-PAT gained 5.71% with a 7.14% price gap; TU-PF up 5.31%; MIPF declined 4.74%; SSTRT released Q2 earnings; PROSPECT announced a capital increase.
TFM reported Q2 earnings and a capital‑change utilization filing, with no notable price movement.

Sharp intraday drop (-33.33%) despite low volume.
Price gap -10.00% and +11.11% intraday move; bondholder meeting filing.
Price gap up +7.14% and +5.71% daily rise.

Unusual price gaps exceeding 10% in XBIO, JCK, and TPOLY.
Large volume spikes in SQ and EMC may signal short‑term pressure.
Asset disposal filings at AMATA and AMATAV could impact property valuations.
